assumptions: Robot-free demonstrations include synchronized wrist imagery and tracked hand/pelvis/foot poses.
A target-robot IK preview is available during collection.
A hierarchical high-level visuomotor policy and low-level whole-body tracker execute the demonstrations.
environments: seven training scenes and four unseen evaluation scenes for squat-and-pick
simulators: paper-reported simulation training environment; exact public code/config unverified

confidence_rationale: The paper includes real-robot task results and targeted interface ablations with large effect sizes, and the official project page corroborates the system identity and demonstrations. Confidence is capped by one robot, small 10-20 trial ablations, experienced operators, custom hardware/external tracking, and an unverified public code repository.

evidence.locator: Figures 2-7, Sections II-IV and VI, Appendix B-F, and Appendix Tables I-III
evidence.note: Supports human-in-loop IK adaptation, whole-body keypoints, chunk-reference and relative-keypoint interfaces, collection throughput, task success, and deployment rates.

evidence.locator: Official project page capability and portable-data-collection sections captured 2026-08-10
evidence.note: Confirms the authors' public project identity and demonstrations; advertised Code/Dataset links remain unverified and are not used as code evidence.

question: 无机器人参与的人形全身操作示范，是否只记录双手轨迹就足够？
statement: 在 HuMI 的自定义夹爪 Unitree G1 与所测任务中，仅记录双手不足以稳定表达深蹲、跪地和移动操作；采集手/骨盆/脚轨迹并用目标机器人实时 IK 预览约束示范，再配合面向跟踪误差设计的高低层接口，显著优于论文中的去除预览或去除全身 specification 消融，但该结果依赖外部 VIVE、熟练操作者和任务专用低层策略。
